result.summary: The screen is mostly usable, but a broken delivery-fee value (€NaN) is clearly incorrect, and several list items clip names or sit too close to the screen edge.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows “€NaN delivery” instead of a real fee. NaN is a failed number format and looks broken.
issues.suggestion: Guard null/invalid fees and show a fallback such as “Free delivery”, “Delivery fee unavailable”, or a formatted euro amount.

issues.description: The last “Fastest near you” card is clipped: the restaurant name reads “Trattoria Piccol” and the image is cut off at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent card width, padding, and text overflow (ellipsis or two-line wrap) so names stay readable in the horizontal list.

issues.description: Category chips overflow the screen (“Healthy” and the next chip are cut off) with no clear hint that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Keep a peek of the next chip and enough end padding, or add a fade so the horizontal scroll is obvious.

issues.description: The Green Bowl Poké thumbnail is very washed out against the light card, so the dish is hard to see compared with the other tiles.
issues.suggestion: Increase image contrast or use a slightly darker card/background so the food stays visible.
